authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism in lighting, shadows, and material rendering. However, specific structural artifacts prevent a perfect score: 1) The junction where the black telescopic handle meets the transparent body shows slight 'melting' or blending rather than a crisp mechanical fit. 2) The rear wheels on the right suitcase exhibit minor geometric distortion and lack the clean definition of the front wheels. 3) Subtle warping in the background window frame lines. These are localized defects that do not compromise the overall scene but indicate AI generation limitations in complex mechanical assemblies.
